scout.title: Culvert marked on the shift board
scout.copy: Foreman Dena Pike taps the chalk mark beside the dark lamp. “You found where the water got through. I marked it for the next crew.”

help.title: Warning lamp relit
help.copy: Iona Kells sets her dry dispatch on the desk. Dena hangs the lit lamp above it. “Iona said you waited until she was clear.”

pass.title: Relief crew due at dawn
pass.copy: The foreman leaves the normal shift notice up. The breakwater route remains open.

scout.title: Lower tunnel marked
scout.copy: Lift keeper Wren Moss adds your lamp marks to the shift map. “The lower tunnel has a way back out.”

help.title: The lift crew is home
help.copy: A returning worker hangs a lamp in the stone shop window. Wren points to its light. “Stones and Beyond will know that token.”

pass.title: Today’s lift hours
pass.copy: The keeper pins the next ordinary shift to the lift office door. The stone shop stays open as usual.

scout.title: Survey plot circled
scout.copy: A student draws a ring around the old grove. “The chart agrees with your tracks. I’ll take that survey after class.”

help.title: Notebook returned to the academy
help.copy: The field notebook is open behind glass, with a signed author card. “We kept the author’s name this time,” a student says.

pass.title: The academy’s survey timetable
pass.copy: The field case advertises the next class. The old grove is still blank on the chart.

scout.title: Thicket warning posted
scout.copy: Warden Rook Alder draws tracks beside the old bell mark. “I’ve flagged the sound for the next patrol.”

help.title: Shift warning acknowledged
help.copy: Your warning slip is clipped to the duty board. Rook taps the signature beneath it. “This time someone knew where we were headed.”

pass.title: Next warden shift
pass.copy: The duty desk displays the normal patrol hours. The lane toward the lake is open.

scout.title: Reed gap mapped
scout.copy: A keeper marks your break in the reeds on the visitors’ map, where the boardwalk passes the water.

help.title: Returned tags on display
help.copy: Night warden Edda Marr takes the enclosure tags out of a drawer and hangs them on the board. “If anyone lost one, they’ll know where to ask.”

pass.title: Safari check-in
pass.copy: A keeper checks the boardwalk list. The ticket booth and Game Corner are open.

scout.title: Dispatcher's private note
scout.copy: A covered dish sits inside a reused crate. Nera Vale folds your scrap of map. “Put the shelter in my copy. Leave it off the public board.”

help.title: Emergency cabinet open
help.copy: Nera puts the accepted manifest beside the unlocked cabinet. “This gives us a place to start.”

pass.title: Freight notice
pass.copy: The depot board lists the routine freight times. A dispatcher compares them to the clock.

scout.title: Training call identified
scout.copy: The lookout clips a marked scrap behind the relay glass. “I know that call. Check your lead before the next match.”

help.title: Emergency beacon lit
help.copy: The beacon glows by the road. “Someone on the high path answered,” the lookout says. “I’ll keep the light here.”

pass.title: Highcountry weather report
pass.copy: A routine forecast is pinned to the relay door. The next report is due after the shift.

scout.title: A second lantern at the pool
scout.copy: The keeper puts a spare lantern near the water. “Someone before you described the same face in there.”

help.title: The chapel steps are lit
help.copy: A tired traveler pauses beside the lit stairs. “I could see the steps from across the water.”

pass.title: Chapel entrance
pass.copy: One lantern hangs by the usual door. Its light reaches the first step.

scout.title: Victory Road register
scout.copy: Orin Beck sets the old register on the intake counter. “Keep the notes open while you choose a lead.”

help.title: Pass checked
help.copy: The League worker marks the pass clear in the radio log and thanks you for staying at the bridge.

pass.title: League registration
pass.copy: Registration is open, and a worker takes a seat beside the route radio.

listen.title: Gate-token sketch
listen.copy: At the lift office the keeper sketches the dented stamp beside a drawing of the matching bolt hole.

act.title: Survey line live
act.copy: A small indicator at the lift office shows Mara’s repaired survey line is working. Two ticks separate it from the lift’s own controls.

listen.title: R-17 counterfoil
listen.copy: The counterfoil is under glass in the records room. The code R-17 and the authorized signature are both legible.

act.title: R-17 plate rubbing
act.copy: A rubbing on the records-room table matches the chipped ring on the R-17 stamp.

listen.title: Private duty-desk appointment
listen.copy: Mara’s slip asks the ranger to confirm the call number away from the duty board. The clerk’s name stays off the notice.

act.title: Redacted transfer copy
act.copy: A copy laid out after the clerk’s shift aligns the tags with L-06. A paper strip keeps the clerk’s initials covered.

listen.title: Signed Route 6 call log
listen.copy: A copy at the ranger booth includes Ivo’s request to stop the truck.

act.title: Gatehouse weight duplicate
act.copy: The duplicate at the ranger booth gives the load’s weight beside the inked word “Empty.”

listen.title: Weigh-slip at Bay Nine
listen.copy: Nera puts the copy in a comparison sleeve so she can check it against the yard ledger.

act.title: A clean tackle box
act.copy: The depot has Mara’s empty tackle box. A note under the handle says the rescued Krabby started eating again.

listen.title: Private relay recording
listen.copy: The recording sleeve quotes Ivo: “I won’t give them my name over a freight radio.” A small tag directs the listener to the old relay.

act.title: Dry blanket at the relay
act.copy: A shelter crew blanket plugs the cracked window. A volunteer has left a lamp beside the path they showed you.

listen.title: Ivo’s signed distress time
listen.copy: Ina has the signed copy filed away. It identifies Ivo and leaves the hikers’ names private.

act.title: Coat drying below the chapel
act.copy: Beside the stairs a hiker waits for a coat to dry. “We heard the trail warning,” they say. “The lookout got us off the main road.”

listen.title: Keeper statement accepted
listen.copy: At intake, Ina’s statement has a permission line and an acceptance stamp.

act.title: Carbon impression filed
act.copy: The disputed return file holds the impression. Its closure time is wrong, and a cover sheet keeps the names out of public view.

listen.title: Sealed certified copy
listen.copy: At the Crucible service entrance, the sealed complaint copy is marked for the player and the other authorized parties.

act.title: The inquiry address
act.copy: The noticeboard carries the case number and the address where the inquiry will be answered. No private witness is named.

listen.title: Ivo’s private note
listen.copy: Ivo approves this copy for your own record. The other witnesses can speak when they choose.

act.title: Public correction filed
act.copy: The public correction carries Ivo’s signature. The other witnesses are unnamed.

rocket.title: A truck without a logo
rocket.copy: The route stand has a new public notice. Where the Rocket logo used to be, the truck door shows a patch of clean paint.

magma.title: Water carried up the hill
magma.copy: A neighbor measures a bucket from the well and takes it up to the highest houses.

aqua.title: Swimming beside the repaired quay
aqua.copy: Beyond patched sandbags, a parent stays within reach as a child practices the same stroke over and over.

galactic.title: Two clocks disagree
galactic.copy: Someone remembers asking the time. Across the square, two residents are having an ordinary argument about who will fix the fence.

plasma.title: Space beside the fire
plasma.copy: Your partner settles beside you without being called. You make room.

flare.title: A redacted list
flare.copy: A fresh notice asks who approved the old lists. The names are folded away from the street.

skull.title: Check-in at the old house
skull.copy: A paper rota lists who is making meals and who will check on the former residents tonight.

yell.title: The show poster came down
yell.copy: Pale corners mark where a tour poster used to hang. Someone has covered the old date with the venue’s ordinary hours.

macroCosmos.title: Fresh paint, old contract
macroCosmos.copy: The new corporate sign is still drying. The familiar clause is on the paper beneath it.

star.title: The kitchen rota
star.copy: The list on the kitchen wall names the people taking meals and the people cooking them.

cubone.title: A stone set back
cubone.copy: One loose cairn stone is back where the rain moved it.

variants.accepted: The loose stone is back in its place. The grandmother’s letter lies below the unfinished cairn.
variants.declined: A loose stone is back in its place. The open space beside the cairns is still empty.

yamask.title: A mask in the window
yamask.copy: The window mask faces the light. No tag gives it a name.

hypno.title: A return notice
hypno.copy: A new strip on the old route notice reads FOUND. Any account of what happened belongs to the people who returned.

phantump.title: The list stops
phantump.copy: The list has no new name. The small shoe is gone from the path.

mimikyu.title: A seam repaired
mimikyu.copy: A careful stitch shows at the seam in the costume on display.

variants.seen: A careful stitch shows at the seam of the costume, set where the light can reach it.
variants.away: The costume sits a little farther from the glass. Its seam is repaired, and the cloth has been left undisturbed.

drifloon.title: Wind report on the post
drifloon.copy: The lookout’s report notes that two walkers reached shelter together.

parasect.title: A question at the empty chair
parasect.copy: The clerk waits behind the familiar chair. There is time to ask when anyone last heard from the missing trainer.

mewtwo.title: A repaired lab seal
mewtwo.copy: A dated seal covers the door. The familiar file number is still visible through the glass.
